title: SEC0: saturating_add(1) on u32::MAX breaks max_literal_size < max_command_size invariant
description: mod.rs lines 152-160: options.max_command_size = cmd_cap.max(options.max_literal_size.saturating_add(1)). When max_literal_bytes >= u32::MAX, max_literal_size = u32::MAX and saturating_add(1) = u32::MAX, yielding max_command_size = u32::MAX = max_literal_size. The imap-next library requires strict max_literal_size < max_command_size (server.rs line 41 comment). With both at u32::MAX the invariant is violated silently. Fix: clamp max_literal_bytes to u32::MAX - 1 before casting, so saturating_add(1) always produces a strictly larger value.
